recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-34120. Any remaining concern about $translate output dependsOn/product allowed types should be reviewed under the output-specific or later ConceptMap issues rather than by changing the FHIR-34120 input parameter.
issue_request: FHIR-34120 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to change the $translate input dependency.concept CodeableConcept to dependency.value with Element allowed types matching the then-current FHIR-28284 ConceptMap dependsOn.value[x] model.
initial_application: The request was applied in commit 76d47fab4b990e9c6b97d9f26b97ee57126df137 on source/conceptmap2/operationdefinition-ConceptMap2-translate.xml and examples, then merged by fbcc847ae2d73cbc1f4065b84d70555927ad3b6c. Later ConceptMap2-to-ConceptMap refactoring and 646720401223f784271c0f6c478484a47094dc06 carried the input forward and converted allowed-type extensions to allowedType elements.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini. The current operation input has dependency.value as Element with allowed types code, Coding, string, boolean, and Quantity. That differs from the original FHIR-34120 list because later Published issue FHIR-40504 revised ConceptMap additionalAttribute/dependsOn/product semantics; the current ConceptMap.group.element.target.dependsOn.value[x] source uses the same code, Coding, string, boolean, Quantity set. Vocab minutes from 2021-11-08 corroborate that the FHIR-28284/FHIR-30515/FHIR-34120 change family had been applied, and no Zulip evidence was found that changes the conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing integer, dateTime, decimal, uri, or id to the input parameter would conflict with the later current ConceptMap model rather than completing FHIR-34120.
